name: 41-45 Barton Street Katoomba data centre proposal
developer: Council Approval Group / Thurlow Group Australia
notes: Blue Mountains City Council welcomed withdrawal of the development application for a data centre at 41 Barton Street, Katoomba. DCD reported the original proposal as a 3,118 sqm facility at 41-45 Barton Street with three generator buildings and AUD 4.8m estimated cost; community reporting described it as a 1-2 MW industrial data centre. Capacity recorded as midpoint because official capacity was not published in trade coverage.

name: Commonwealth Bank Burwood Data Centre Modernisation
notes: Public evidence is weak but consistent: iTnews covered CBA's modernised Sydney data centre, Star Group lists Commonwealth Bank data centre implementation/upgrade work and EDS Data Centre Burwood among data centre projects, and multiple public LinkedIn profiles reference CBA's Burwood Data Centre Modernisation program in 2017-2019. Exact address, operating status and capacity were not publicly confirmed.
